sources.title: Granola raises $125M, hits $1.5B valuation as it expands from meeting notetaker to enterprise AI app
sources.evidence_summary: Article states Granola raised a $125M Series C at a $1.5 billion valuation, led by Danny Rimer at Index Ventures with Mamoon Hamid at Kleiner Perkins, and names Lightspeed, Spark and NFDG as participating existing investors.
